name: HeyTraders
description: Operate the live HeyTraders browser command catalog through an origin-pinned WebMCP adapter.

appOrigin.description: Exact HeyTraders app origin. Defaults to production; HTTP is accepted only for loopback or host.docker.internal development.

agentDisplayName.description: Display name for the autonomous HeyTraders Agent-owned account.

browserProfile.description: OpenClaw browser profile that owns the authorized HeyTraders tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for browser discovery and one HeyTraders command.
